propositions: Six files sit within 7 lines of the 800-LOC module size cap, with three at exactly 800 LOC, blocking new feature work such as d23e's deprecation alias.

ADR 0056's refactoring method (extracting absorbing verbs, data-driven tables, and domain seams) successfully relieved runner.py from 689 to 647 LOC but was not applied to the next tier of high-centrality, high-churn modules.
llm/config.py (793 LOC, 93 fan-in, 16 churn per 400 commits, 7 lines headroom) is the most central near-cap file and cannot accommodate one new config knob (typically 10-13 lines).
The per-function length gate was rejected by the operator as too high blast radius; module-level rework plus seam tests are the only remaining defence against absorber regrowth.

Relocation alone (without dissolving an absorber) must be explicitly marked as mass-moving rather than claiming permanence, and seam tests with headroom guards are load-bearing for preventing regression.
